description: VyPlate by VySpine is an anterior cervical plate with intuitive locking, torx drive, and large graft windows, indicated for stabilization of the anterior cervical spine. Plates and screws come in various sizes to provide optimal patient specific fit, and large graft windows enable visualization of the underlying anatomy during insertion. The intuitive integrated locking mechanism utilizes the same driver as the bone screws, and the plate/screw interface features a robust torx drive to reduce the chance of stripping. Plates come pre-lordosed, but lordosis can customized with the plate bender, bending the plate within the designated bending zones.
